label: At GO, grows with belief S1 is good; boosted by reward, most after a prior non-reward.
terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (belief_lo > 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief_lo > 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (belief_lo > 0)
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2); timing baseline declines over the episode. Beyond timing, magnitude rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (an a1-favouring signal; residual -0.3 for belief deciles 0-3, +0.5 for 8-9) and, when belief favours S1, is boosted after a rewarded previous trial, most strongly on the first reward after a non-reward (activations ~2.5-3 then decaying over consecutive rewards). Previous a1 S1 r and a1 S2 u raise it, other patterns lower it. The free fit adds belief x episode-decile interactions and last-trial pattern indicators (dev 0.47 vs short 0.37); remaining misses: over-prediction after a2 S1 r and a1 S2 r, under-prediction on window-first trials, and the decay across a reward run is not captured.
